### last time

*  deadlock conditions
*  deadlock prevention strategies like
   *  (most common) consistent lock order [prevent loops]
   *  abort and maybe retry (but livelock)
*  monitors
   *  condition variable = list of waiting threads
   *  wait() in loop; broadcast() or signal() to wake-up

### some feedback on test question 3

*  TLB question had more of a memorizable "trick" than I really wanted
   *  didn't think through how easily it would tend to "memorize numerical answer strategy without understanding what goes on"
   *  would help to have varied parameters more (but I avoided to keep calculations simple)
   *  possibly too cute to ask for "any possible" address
*  appreciate feedback since I would like to improve tests, homeworks for the future
